description: No hardcoded secrets in source code
fix: Move secrets to .env and access via pydantic-settings Settings class

description: All YAML config files must have a commented options header
check: for f in config/settings/*.yaml; do head -1 "$f" | rg -q '^#' || echo "MISSING HEADER: $f"; done
fix: Add a # ============= header block listing all available options at the top of each YAML file

description: Config schemas use extra='forbid' to catch unknown keys
fix: All config schema classes must set extra='forbid' to reject typos in YAML

description: No os.getenv() with hardcoded fallback defaults in module code
fix: Secrets come from pydantic-settings, app config from YAML. No hardcoded fallbacks.

description: No hardcoded pricing — all LLM pricing must come from config/pricing.yaml. Matches an actual literal value assigned to a pricing-shaped name (or a bare dollar literal), not the mere presence of a field name — a naive substring match on 'per_token' also matches budget.py's legitimate ModelPricing Pydantic field type annotations (input_per_token: float), which are not hardcoded values.
fix: All pricing data must be in config/pricing.yaml and loaded by budget.py _load_pricing()

description: No hardcoded model strings — all LLM model identifiers must come from config
scope: src/security_review/**/*.py (excluding config_schema.py, providers.py, model_settings.py, and the copilot_model.py/claude_model.py/codex_model.py provider-adapter default model_id fallbacks)
fix: Model strings come from config/settings/security_review.yaml via SecurityReviewConfig.llm.provider_model

description: No silent defaults — fail fast and loud. Required config fields have no Pydantic default. Optional fields default to None or 0, never to a 'sensible' value. Config loaders raise ConfigurationError on missing files, empty YAML, or absent keys.
fix: Remove the default= value. If the field must come from YAML, make it required (no default). If it is genuinely optional, default to None.
